name: omnilab/worms
description: Omnilab WoRMS: a taxon of the World Register of Marine Species by its AphiaID, its name, or the ITIS TSN, NCBI taxon or IUCN id WoRMS knows it by - accepted name and status, classification, synonyms, vernacular names, habitat flags, the citation WoRMS asks for, its ITIS, NCBI and IUCN ids as cross-references - and a search of names, through the WoRMS REST service, no key needed.
